name: Command Palette UI
description: Ctrl+P fuzzy file finder overlay with input, progress indicator, filtered file results, and recent file tracking.

dom.root: .palette-overlay (position: fixed, inset: 0, background: rgba(0,0,0,0.5), display: flex, justify-content: center, padding-top: 15vh, z-index: 9999)
children: .palette-modal (background: var(--surface), border: 1px dashed var(--border), border-radius: 8px, width: 500px, max-height: 400px, display: flex, flex-direction: column, box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.4))
.palette-input (width: 100%, background: transparent, border: none, outline: none, color: var(--text), font: 14px Space Mono, placeholder: 'Search files...')
.palette-progress (height: 2px, background: var(--accent), transition: width 200ms, hidden when idle)
.palette-item (padding: 8px 12px, cursor: pointer, display: flex, justify-content: space-between, align-items: center)

interactions.name: search
interactions.action: Filter file index against input text using substring/fuzzy match → Re-render .palette-results with matches
interactions.result: Results list updates to show matching files

interactions.name: navigate_down
interactions.action: Move .active class to next .palette-item, scroll into view if needed

interactions.name: navigate_up
interactions.action: Move .active class to previous .palette-item, scroll into view if needed

interactions.name: select
interactions.action: Fire onOpenFile callback with selected path → Close palette
interactions.result: File opened in editor, palette closed

interactions.name: close
interactions.trigger: Escape keydown or click on .palette-overlay background

states.idle: Overlay visible, input focused, progress bar hidden, results show recent files or all files
states.indexing: Progress bar visible and animating while file tree is being walked via IPC fs:readDir
states.results: Filtered results displayed, keyboard navigation active
states.empty: No files match the search query — 'No files found' message shown
